label: conj:sm-colour-stabilizer-action
title: Colour stabilizer action on the state space
html:
Conjecture. Colour stabilizer action on the state space

We conjecture that the colour algebra acts faithfully and linearly on the framework's state space: writing \mathfrak{g} for the colour algebra — the intended realisation is the stabilizer \mathfrak{su}(3) = \ker(\mathrm{ev}_e) \subset \mathrm{Der}(\mathbb{O}) of a unit imaginary octonion, the Günaydin–Gürsey colour subalgebra, carried here with the proved gate \dim \mathfrak{su}(3) = 8 \iff \mathrm{rank}(\mathrm{ev}_e) = 6 — there is an injective \mathbb{Q}-linear map

  \Phi \colon \mathfrak{g} \longrightarrow \mathrm{End}(V)

into the endomorphisms of the three-strand state space V. This is the missing \mathrm{SU}(3) ingredient of the truncation conjecture at the infinitesimal level: the colour algebra is constructed here [baez2002] [dubois-violette2016] but no construction makes it act on the states. Bracket compatibility is the natural strengthening, deliberately omitted from the class so that the conjecture records only the minimal missing ingredient; bracket closure of the concrete stabilizer is itself proved — \mathfrak{su}(3) = \ker(\mathrm{ev}_e) is closed under the commutator, hence a Lie subalgebra of \mathrm{Der}(\mathbb{O}) = \mathfrak{g}_2, since [D_1,D_2]\,e = D_1(D_2 e) - D_2(D_1 e) = 0 — so the strengthening is stateable whenever the conjectured \Phi materialises.

Two consequences are proved unconditionally in the Lean formalization. First, the dimension obstruction: a faithful linear action forces \dim \mathfrak{g} \leq (\dim V)^2. Second, its instantiation at the colour dimension: an 8-dimensional colour algebra admits no faithful action on a state space of dimension \leq 2, since 2^2 = 4 < 8 \leq 3^2 = 9 — so three strands are the minimal faithful colour host. The framework's three-strand baryon structure is thereby not an aesthetic choice but the smallest state space on which the octonionic colour symmetry could act at all; conversely, any proposed colour action on a smaller space is excluded by the cited rank invariant, not merely unlikely.

A calibration proved after the class was first stated sharpens where the open content lives. The abstract class quantifies over an arbitrary state space, and it is satisfied — tautologically — by the octonion base module itself: \mathfrak{su}(3) = \ker(\mathrm{ev}_e) is by construction a submodule of \mathrm{End}(\mathbb{O}), so the inclusion realises the faithful action on \mathbb{O} = \mathbb{C} \oplus \mathbb{C}^3, the \mathbf{1} \oplus \mathbf{3} colour decomposition of [dubois-violette-todorov2018]. The Lean instance records exactly how far this tautology reaches. What remains conjectural — and is the intended content of the conjecture — is the action on the framework's own three-strand Hecke state space: an injective \Phi whose target is the braid-state module, compatible with its Hecke structure, not merely some faithful module somewhere.
